_: Per-suite end-to-end durations, harvested from ONE real CI run. WHAT THIS IS: the input to the shard assignment in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so that assignment is derived from data rather than from an impression. Consumed only by check:e2e-roster's PRINTED summary. WHAT THIS IS NOT: a budget, a bar, or anything any gate asserts against. No test compares a wall-clock time to a number in this file, and none may: docs/specs/ci-sharding/feature-spec.md 1.4 forbids a wall-clock assertion anywhere in this epic, because five samples of the same job span 40-47 minutes and the slowest measured altered no test at all. These are ratios that happen to carry units. STALENESS: the run id and date below are printed beside every projection, so a reader sees the projection's age at the same time as the projection. They will drift as suites are added and that is expected; re-harvest rather than trusting them. ADDENDUM 2026-09-17: test:e2e:page-composition (ADR-0146) carries 32 and test:e2e:forced-colors (ADR-0146 M7) carries 9, and they are the figures here not harvested from the run named below — they are local measurements of each suite's own first green run, recorded because the alternative is what check:e2e-roster does with an unknown suite: charge it the largest measured duration, which projected its shard at 822 s against a 593 s budget for a suite that takes half a minute. A pessimistic default is the right rule for a gate and the wrong number for a reader. Re-harvest with the rest.
residualCheck: The 46 web durations sum to 2090 s. It was 2049 s across 44 suites, matching the independently-recorded 2,049 s of the CI-sharding measurement exactly - residual 0 s. The difference is two entries: test:e2e:page-composition at 32 s and test:e2e:forced-colors at 9 s, both added 2026-09-17 and measured locally rather than harvested (see the ADDENDUM above). The forced-colours figure is the SUITE's 8.6 s wall clock and deliberately EXCLUDES its ~40 s production build, which is the honest thing for a projection whose subject is per-suite test time and the dishonest thing for anyone reading it as 'what this step costs CI' - it is the same shape as the CSP suite, which is placed on shard 1 for exactly that reason and is why this one joins it there. The check still does what it exists for - a hand-edit cannot pass unnoticed - and this edit is recorded rather than hidden by rounding it into a neighbour.
keyedBy: The package.json SCRIPT NAME, not the CI step's title and not a prose suite label. A title is prose; the script is the key check:e2e-roster derives its own roster from, so the two cannot drift apart. Verified as an exact set equality in both directions against apps/web/package.json (44) and apps/api/package.json (2) on 2026-09-11.
